newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber narrowly mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber narrowly mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in directionless after-hours trade on Wednesday, as the stalled gains in the dollar against the yen pressured the market, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 0.1 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.4 yen lower at 142.8 yen. Volume was thin with only 7,113 lots traded.
During the day, prices drifted within tight ranges.
"Direction hinges on the currency market amid a lack of other fresh incentives," one trader said.
